_help.allow_experienced_roles: false = only intern/new-grad/entry-level postings pass the fit gate (today's default). true = the fit gate also allows postings requiring 3+ years of experience, set by checking "Full time (3+ yrs exp)" in the Settings Levels submenu.
_help.ashby_company_slugs: Company slugs (from an Ashby job-board URL, e.g. jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>) to scrape directly via the Ashby API.
_help.lever_company_slugs: Company slugs (from a Lever job-board URL, e.g. jobs.lever.co/<slug>) to scrape directly via the Lever API.
_help.greenhouse_company_slugs: Company slugs (from a Greenhouse job-board URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>) to scrape directly via the Greenhouse jobs API.
_help.smartrecruiters_company_slugs: Company identifiers (from a SmartRecruiters careers URL, e.g. jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<identifier>) to scrape directly via the public SmartRecruiters Postings API.
_help.workable_company_slugs: Company account slugs (from a live Workable posting URL, e.g. apply.workable.com/<slug>/j/...) to scrape directly via Workable's public widget API. Never guess a slug from a company's public name: confirmed live 2026-08-10 that guessed name-based slugs 404 or return a permanently empty jobs array; find the real slug from an actual live posting URL. Verified live examples (2026-08-10): tarte-inc, quickrelease, powerlines.
_help.jazzhr_company_slugs: Company account subdomains (from a live JazzHR posting URL, e.g. <slug>.applytojob.com/apply/jobs/details/...) to scrape via HTML parsing: JazzHR has no public API. Same never-guess-a-slug rule as Workable. Verified live examples (2026-08-10): empowerproject, ilsos.
_help.gem_company_slugs: Company slugs (from a Gem job-board URL, e.g. jobs.gem.com/<slug>) to scrape directly via Gem's public GraphQL batch API (jobs.gem.com/api/public/graphql/batch: a real, unauthenticated, public endpoint, confirmed live 2026-07-26).
_help.simplify_feeds: Named community listing-tracker feeds to pull from; see src/scripts/jobs/fetch_simplify_listings.py's FEEDS dict for the exhaustive, current list. As of Phase 16B: "summer_internships", "new_grad" (SimplifyJobs), "vanshb03_summer_internships", "vanshb03_new_grad" (vanshb03, a separately-scraped sibling tracker sharing the same schema, real incremental coverage, not a duplicate).
_help.workday_tenants: Workday tenant identifiers ("<host>/<site>") to scrape; see docs/SETUP.md for how to find a tenant string. Verified live examples (2026-07-25): salesforce.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site, nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite. As of phase 7D (2026-08-28) Workday candidates tailor and apply via the deterministic local runtime, not review-only.
_help.workday_alias_email: The managed mail.aplyx.app alias that Workday account-verification mail is sent to (phase 7D, 2026-08-28). Required before the local Workday runtime can create an account: a missing/placeholder value routes Workday jobs to needs_review with a configuration message instead of applying. The local harness has no inbox service to retrieve the verification mail automatically, so even with this set, a Workday application checkpoints at awaiting_verification on the scheduled path and the user supplies the verification link/OTP via Continue Workday to cross it.
_help.workday_prefill_for_review: Documented no-op as of phase 7D (2026-08-28). Predates the Workday auto-apply path and is unused now that Workday reaches the real fill step. Leave false.
_help.oracle_tenants: Oracle Recruiting Cloud tenant identifiers ("<host>/<siteNumber>", e.g. eeho.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/CX_45001 for Oracle's own careers site) to scrape directly via the public Fusion HCM REST API; see docs/SETUP.md. Verified live examples (2026-07-25): egug.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/CX_1 (American Express), jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/CX_1001 (JPMorgan Chase).
_help.eightfold_tenants: Eightfold-powered careers site tenant identifiers ("<host>/<domain>", e.g. apply.careers.microsoft.com/microsoft.com): a white-labeled ATS with no common hostname suffix across tenants, so each one has to be found by hand (inspect the employer's careers site network requests for an api/pcsx/search or api/apply/v2/jobs call). Verified live examples (2026-07-25): apply.careers.microsoft.com/microsoft.com, explore.jobs.netflix.net/netflix.com.
